text: Not every buyer needs a bank.
I've closed deals in days other agents said would take months.
The secret isn't luck, it's knowing your numbers before you walk in.
Most buyers panic about financing and let sellers control every term.
But when you control your numbers, you control the negotiation.
Your financials tell a story before you say a word.
Income, savings, credit, all of it.
I walk every client through their real numbers first, then we build a strategy around exactly what works for them.
One honest conversation can save you thousands.
That's just how good deals actually close.
So before you sign anything, call someone who protects you.
